prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: four paper building blocks; tape pieces.
Opens on the arrow, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the arrow splits into four paper building blocks, taped side by side.
Ends holding on the taped block row.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "4 ACQUISITIONS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "4 ACQUISITIONS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The company is in active integration mode across four acquisitions.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage style, presented as a 2D motion design photographed flat under soft, neutral room light. <Picture 1> establishes the initial composition: a soft violet, single-color paper ground. In the upper third, a cream-colored paper chip with the text "INTEGRATION TAX" in bold black sans-serif is held by four pieces of semi-transparent matte tape. In the lower two-thirds, a yellow paper arrow sits atop two black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges. The lighting comes from the upper left, casting small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer.

As the video begins, the camera remains a Static Shot. The cream chip reading "INTEGRATION TAX" and its associated tape pieces slide rapidly off the top edge of the frame. Simultaneously, the yellow paper arrow in the center splits and transforms through a fast motion with a slight overshoot into four distinct paper building blocks. These four blocks are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn edges, arranged side-by-side and secured by small pieces of matte cream tape.

At the same moment the "INTEGRATION TAX" chip exits, a new cream paper chip slides in from the top to occupy the upper third of the frame. This chip features the text "4 ACQUISITIONS" in extra-bold black sans-serif; the lettering is clean, legible, and stable. The four taped building blocks in the lower section hold a steady position for the remainder of the video, with a very subtle, slow looping movement to maintain a sense of life. All surfaces remain matte printed paper with no glow or neon effects. An English narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range timbre speaking at a brisk but unhurried pace, says: <d>[English] The company is in active integration mode across four acquisitions.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by a clear, professional voiceover. Beneath the speech, distinct diegetic sound effects of paper slapping against a flat surface and the tactile, sticky peel and press of adhesive tape are heard in synchronization with the sliding and splitting motions.
